presets.label: Soft Reader
presets.description: Medium-weight warm white text with a gentle dim that keeps the whole line easy to read ahead.
askedAs: easy to read captions with light dimming

presets.label: High Contrast
presets.description: Heavy black-weight text where upcoming words nearly vanish, so the spoken word stands out sharply.
askedAs: strong contrast between spoken and upcoming words
make the current word really pop

presets.label: Long Page
presets.description: Smaller text grouped into long pages that linger, so viewers can read full sentences at once.
askedAs: longer caption lines that stay on screen

presets.label: Quick Beats
presets.description: Large bold words in short, snappy pages that clear quickly for fast-paced speech.
askedAs: fast captions a few words at a time

presets.label: Ink On Light
presets.description: Deep charcoal text without shadow, made for bright or white footage and clean slide backgrounds.

presets.label: Amber Subtle
presets.description: Muted amber text with a light shadow-free finish that warms the frame without fighting the footage.
